module_role: Deterministic, redundant avionics network interface (AFDX / ARINC 664 Part 7). An End System connects an LRU to two independent IEEE 802.3 networks (A/B), shapes each Virtual Link to its BAG + jitter, replicates frames with a Sequence Number, and on receive runs per-network Integrity Checking + first-valid-wins Redundancy Management; AFDX Switches forward by VL ID and police each VL.
topology_description: Switched star duplicated as Network A and Network B: End Systems attach by point-to-point full-duplex links to AFDX Switches; Virtual Links define unidirectional source→destination(s) paths over the fabric. UDP/IP rides over the VL.

integration_overview.host_side_register_spec: Static per-VL configuration tables (VL ID, BAG, Lmax/Lmin, Sub-VL count, source/destination ES, switch forwarding + policing, RM enable) plus run-time status counters.

interface_categories: End System host/application interface — sampling and queuing communication ports (UDP/IP).
Network A Ethernet port — full-duplex IEEE 802.3 link to Network A.
Network B Ethernet port — full-duplex IEEE 802.3 link to Network B.
AFDX Switch ports — full-duplex point-to-point links with per-VL policing and static VL-ID forwarding.
interconnect_topologies_supported: Single End System to switch (point-to-point full-duplex).
Dual fabric: Network A and Network B fully independent.
Virtual Link multicast (one source ES → multiple destination ES).
default_signal_values_when_omitted: MII / GMII: TX_EN, TX_ER, RX_DV, RX_ER, CRS, COL default to 0 (de-asserted); TXD / RXD default to 0x0. MDIO defaults to logic-1 (pulled up by the PHY's 1.5 kΩ resistor) when no STA driver is active. After BMCR Reset (0.15 = 1) the PHY restores BMCR + BMSR to spec-defined defaults (AutoNeg Enable = 1 if supported, Isolate = 1 if attached via 22.6 connector).
soc_dependent_items: Number of Virtual Links and their BAG / Lmax / Sub-VL allocation.
Static switch forwarding tables (VL ID → output ports) and policing parameters.
Communication-port map (sampling/queuing, UDP ports, VL binding).
Ethernet PHY selection (100BASE-TX / 10BASE-T) for both network ports.

low_power_modes.Active: Normal operation; MAC + PHY both running.
low_power_modes.Power_Down_BMCR_0_11: PHY in low-power state; MDIO remains responsive; PHY shall not generate spurious MII / GMII activity. Exit latency ≤ 0.5 s.
low_power_modes.Isolate_BMCR_0_10: PHY data paths to MII / GMII are high-Z; PHY remains MDIO-addressable.
low_power_modes.EEE_LPI_Clause_78: Energy Efficient Ethernet Low-Power Idle: PHY signals LPI on the link when MAC has no traffic; transmitter sleep + receiver alert + refresh cycles; not in 802.3-2005 — added in Clause 78.

device_classes_examples: Flight-control / display / sensor LRUs on the AFDX backbone
